predis.ai.notes: Index of 44 sitemaps; 40 files walked. 12 language sitemaps (cs, da, nl, fi, no, pl, ro, sv, id, hu, tr, ms sitemap1.xml) return 410, but those languages still appear in the prune files. 68,179 unique URLs in 58 languages, but English is 1,642. The rest: es, pt, de, it, fr mirrors (1,586 to 1,588 each, 7,938 total) and 52 machine-translated languages (Corsican, Hawaiian, Hmong, Esperanto and others; 1,103 to 1,128 URLs each, 58,599 total) listed in 5 files named sitemap-prune-1 to 5.xml. A random sample of 30 per group (seed 7, no redirects) found 30 of 30 prune URLs return 410, 10 of 30 English blog posts return 410, 5 of 30 main-mirror URLs return 410, and 29 of 30 English site pages return 200. So the machine-translated set is being removed, and part of the English blog with it. robots.txt has 1,577 Disallow lines: 1,442 for /free-ai-tools/ variant pages by occasion or niche (/free-ai-tools/baking/, /free-ai-tools/background-remover/<x>/<y>/) and the rest for per-language and per-niche hashtag generator pages. A pruned programmatic set. English: 1,407 blog posts at /resources/<slug>/. free_tools = 34 /free-ai-tool/<tool>/ generators plus /free-hashtag-generator/, a network by tool grid (bio generators for 8 networks, caption for 5, username for 9). The rendered /free-ai-tools/ hub links 51 tools at /free-ai-tools/<tool>, which redirect to /free-ai-tool/<tool>/. programmatic_tool_pages = 6 leftover /free-ai-tools/<tool>/keyword1 and keyword2 placeholder pages that redirect to the hub. features_product = 79, mostly per-network and per-format maker pages: 21 /create/<x> (youtube-thumbnail, linkedin-banner), 15 /use-cases/<x>-maker, 6 /api/ pages and root makers. integrations = 16 /ai-models/<model> pages plus the hub (Kling, Veo, Seedance and others), 8 /mcp/<x> pages plus the hub, and Shopify. comparison = 7 /compare/ pages (4 category roundups) and 9 /review/<competitor> pages. platform_pages = 6 /integrations/predis-for-<network>, 4 /<network>-scheduler and 2 auto-post pages. help_docs = 48 developer docs. buckets_all_languages: machine-translated paths use translated folder names (/az/resurslar.../), so most non-English URLs fall in other there; the primary-language table is not affected.
